field.label: Name
field.help: Short name, used for the alias gwsw_name. Letters, digits and underscores.

field.label: IPv4 gateway
field.help: Gateway or gateway group the IPv4 traffic of clients in this profile leaves through, for example the WireGuard gateway.

field.label: IPv6
field.help: Route IPv6 through an IPv6 gateway when the tunnel has one. Otherwise reject IPv6 for these clients, so apps fall back to IPv4 at once.

field.label: IPv6 gateway
field.help: Only used when IPv6 is routed.

field.label: Outbound NAT
field.help: Create outbound NAT on the gateway's interface, translating clients to the tunnel address (NAT66 for IPv6). Needed for almost every commercial VPN.
